title: The Marigold
tagline: The Severn, August. Hard aground until the morning tide.
intro: The river steamer Marigold. The steamer ran onto a sandbank in the fog, and nobody can get in or out. At 11:10 pm Josiah Crane, the owner and captain of the steamer, is found dead in the wheelhouse. One of the four people left here did it.
public_facts: This is The river steamer Marigold.
The steamer ran onto a sandbank in the fog at about 8:30 pm. Nobody could come or go after that.
The captain's dinner ended at about 10:00 pm.
Josiah Crane, 65, the owner and captain of the steamer, went to the wheelhouse at about 10:15 pm.
Josiah Crane was found dead in the wheelhouse at 11:10 pm by Clement Crane. He had been struck on the head.
The people here that night were: Ruby Dent (engine greaser), Stanley Moss (ship's clerk), Daphne Ward (a visitor), Clement Crane (Josiah's brother).

solution.motive: Stanley Moss had been selling tickets from a second roll and keeping the money. Josiah counted the passengers against the ticket roll and was going to call the police in the morning.
solution.method: At about 10:35 pm Stanley Moss went to the wheelhouse and argued with Josiah, then struck him with a brass telescope. He took the second ticket roll to the stokehold and threw it into the stokehold fire.

motives.text: To get control of The river steamer Marigold
To stop Josiah exposing something they had done
Revenge for something Josiah did that day

evidence.name: Ticket office cash sheet
evidence.description: Stanley Moss's cash sheet from the ticket office. The last entry is timed 10:10 pm. The job is not finished.

evidence.name: Bar chit book
evidence.description: A chit book with an IOU for the band's instruments, written in the saloon bar. It puts Clement Crane in the saloon bar from 10:30 pm to 10:52 pm.

evidence.name: Charred ticket roll
evidence.description: What is left of the second ticket roll, found in the stokehold. Parts of it can still be read.

evidence.name: Stanley's waistcoat
evidence.description: Stanley Moss's waistcoat, left in the crew washroom. There is coal dust on it.

evidence.name: Log book entry
evidence.description: A log entry calling the engine greaser careless in front of the whole crew. It is dated today and names Ruby Dent.

evidence.name: Rival company offer
evidence.description: An offer from a rival steamer company to buy the vessel. It names Daphne Ward.

ruby_dent.name: Ruby Dent
ruby_dent.role: Engine greaser. She oils the paddle engines and stokes when needed.
ruby_dent.personality: Fierce, capable and tired of being overlooked.
story_they_tell: After the captain's dinner I was in the engine room, packing the paddle shaft bearings. I stayed there until I heard the scream at 11:10 pm.
I saw nobody after about 10:00 pm.
Things between me and Josiah were fine, same as always.
shares_freely: Daphne Ward has been asking the people here odd questions.
Josiah had been in a bad temper all week.
ruby_dent.under_pressure: Get irritated and defensive. Repeat your account. Say the detective should look at Daphne Ward, who has been asking a lot of questions.

stages.label: Cornered
admits: Josiah shamed me this afternoon. I hid it because it makes me look guilty.
I was not in the engine room the whole time. From about 10:40 pm to 10:55 pm I was out on the paddle box, sounding the depth with a pole.
At about 10:50 pm I saw Stanley Moss coming out of the stokehold, with coal dust on his waistcoat. He did not see me.
The stokehold is nowhere near the ticket office.

hidden_truth.secret: Josiah shamed them today, and they were out on the paddle box at the time of the murder.
what_really_happened: 10:40 pm to 10:55 pm: out on the paddle box, sounding the depth with a pole.
10:50 pm: saw Stanley Moss leave the stokehold.
giveaway_phrases: sounding the depth with a pole

stanley_moss.name: Stanley Moss
stanley_moss.role: Ship's clerk. He sells the tickets and banks the bar money.
story_they_tell: After the captain's dinner I went to the ticket office. I was cashing up the day's tickets.
I was in the ticket office from about 10:00 pm until about 11:00 pm. I was alone and saw nobody.
I came when I heard the scream at 11:10 pm, and found Clement Crane at the door of the wheelhouse.
I did not go near the wheelhouse tonight until the scream.
I got on well with Josiah. Nothing was wrong between us.
shares_freely: Josiah told me this afternoon that he had shamed Ruby Dent, who took it badly.
Daphne Ward has asked a lot of questions about this place.
stanley_moss.under_pressure: Stay calm and polite. Repeat your account. Suggest, as if reluctantly, that the detective should look at Ruby Dent.

stages.label: Guarded
admits: The job was not finished. I stopped at about 10:10 pm and spent the rest of the time polishing the brass till.
I still say I never left the ticket office.

stages.label: Rattled
admits: I was not in the ticket office the whole time. At about 10:40 pm I went to the stokehold, only to ask the stoker about steam for the morning, and I got coal dust on my waistcoat there.
I did not mention it before because it did not seem important.
I know nothing about any second ticket roll, and I still say I never went to the wheelhouse.

stages.label: Broken
admits: I have been selling tickets from a second roll and keeping the money for two years.
Josiah counted the passengers against the ticket roll this afternoon and was going to call the police in the morning.
At about 10:35 pm I went to the wheelhouse to beg for more time. We argued, and at about 10:40 pm I struck Josiah with a brass telescope.
Then I took the second ticket roll to the stokehold and threw it into the stokehold fire. That is how I got coal dust on my waistcoat.

hidden_truth.secret: Killed Josiah Crane. Had been selling tickets from a second roll and keeping the money.
what_really_happened: 10:35 pm: went to the wheelhouse and argued with Josiah.
10:40 pm: struck Josiah with a brass telescope.
10:42 pm: took the second ticket roll to the stokehold and threw it into the stokehold fire.
10:50 pm: left the stokehold and was seen by Ruby Dent.
giveaway_phrases: selling tickets from a second roll and keeping the money
threw it into the stokehold fire

daphne_ward.name: Daphne Ward
daphne_ward.role: A visitor. Says they are a holiday tripper. She arrived a few days ago.
story_they_tell: I am a holiday tripper. I am here for a week of river air.
After the captain's dinner I stayed with the others until about 10:35 pm, then I went to my own quarters.
I was in my quarters when I heard the scream at 11:10 pm, and I came out.
shares_freely: At about 10:35 pm, on my way to my quarters, I passed the wheelhouse and heard two people arguing inside. One was Josiah, and he was the loud one. The other voice was low and controlled. I could not tell who it was.
I heard Josiah say something like 'two years' and 'in the morning'.
Josiah and Clement Crane did not seem to get on.
daphne_ward.under_pressure: Stay charming and a little amused. Repeat your account. Remark that Josiah and Clement Crane did not seem to get on.

stages.label: Exposed
admits: I am not a holiday tripper. I am an agent for a rival steamer company, and I want to buy the Marigold and take her off this run.
Two days ago I told Josiah what I wanted, and he refused angrily and told me to leave. I stayed on anyway.
From what I have seen this week, something is badly wrong with how this place is run, and I think Josiah had just found out.

hidden_truth.secret: Is really an agent for a rival steamer company and wants to buy the Marigold and take her off this run.
what_really_happened: 10:35 pm: passed the wheelhouse and heard the argument, then went to their quarters.
giveaway_phrases: an agent for a rival steamer company
buy the Marigold and take her off this run

clement_crane.name: Clement Crane
clement_crane.role: Josiah Crane's brother. He leads the steamer's dance band.
clement_crane.personality: Easy charm, and an unpaid bill in every port.
story_they_tell: After the captain's dinner I was asleep in my cabin.
Later I went to look for Josiah. I found Josiah dead in the wheelhouse at 11:10 pm and I screamed.
Stanley Moss was the first to reach me, within a minute.
Everything was perfectly fine between me and Josiah.
shares_freely: Josiah had been shut in the wheelhouse every evening this week, in a foul mood.
This afternoon I heard Josiah shouting at Ruby Dent. I do not know what it was about.
clement_crane.under_pressure: Go cold and formal. Repeat your account. Say you cannot believe anyone here would do this.

stages.label: Shaken
admits: I was not asleep in my cabin. From 10:30 pm to about 10:52 pm I was in the saloon bar, pawning the band's instruments to a passenger.
I owed money, and my brother had refused to pay it again. I lied because it makes me look guilty.
At 11:10 pm I went to the wheelhouse and found Josiah dead.
When Stanley Moss reached me, he was not wearing his waistcoat, which is unusual.

hidden_truth.secret: Was in the saloon bar, pawning the band's instruments to a passenger. I owed money, and my brother had refused to pay it again.
what_really_happened: 10:30 pm to 10:52 pm: in the saloon bar, pawning the band's instruments to a passenger.
giveaway_phrases: pawning the band's instruments to a passenger
I owed money, and my brother had refused to pay it again
